rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — all 39 cited source files under `reckon/` and `tests/` exist; `STRANDED_LAUNCH_BOUND_SECONDS`, `_stranded_launch`, `_release_stranded_launches`, `_dead_sections`, `DEAD_RUN_PHASES`, `StationReloader`, `_run_review_tier`, `_sweep_review_tier` and `wait_for_dispatches_in_flight` all resolve; the reckon-local commits `d72a7d9b25`, `e8871a04ee`, `022b666162`, `ee7fb80c4e` and `3b57e76d24` resolve as commit objects; the s25 evidence anchor `#off-node-follower-reads-slow-tick-s25-change` exists; the shorthand cross-plan citations resolve to real sections (`monitor-shows §145`, `landing §14–§16`, `escape-lane §11`, `queued-work §20` = "A clean landing releases its worktree and leaves no held duty"); the two imas-codex commits §18 cites are not commit objects in this repository and are stated as imas-codex evidence, not reckon anchors.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each section's done-when names a new test set with "each failing at the base revision" (or an explicit restored-base mutation for §28/§29, plan.html:223 and 228), so every gate carries a control that must go red on unfixed code; the population clause ("tests importing X add no failure against the base on all_debug") is a measured delta rather than an absolute green.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — landed sections write under `docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-tells-the-truth-under-load/` (22 files present) and §28/§29 state "every log under the run directory"; no gate path names a node-local temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — section bodies name existing symbols only, create no new code path beyond write-scope declarations, and carry no plan labels, ticket numbers, version tags or changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §16's "Why" (plan.html:162) cites "history §21, §22 and §25" as the record of three promotion-refused runs, but those sections of `docs/plans/history-persists-as-detail-washes-out.html` are "The store write is load-bearing", "Every ledger question is answered by the store" and "Presence checks stop keying on a tracked file", and that plan contains no occurrence of `promotion-refused` or the acceptance-inputs refusal; the root-cause narrative stands on its own but the cited evidence does not contain it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — every section names one invariant, and the multi-clause done-whens (§5, §7, §13, §19) are facets of that invariant rather than independent deliverables.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the only open followup (`f-mttu-004`, plan.html:250–254) asks to land §28 and §29, which are both declared `done` and both landed, while the only `implementable` section (§23, plan.html:195–198) is named by no open followup.
